_comment: Portable wiring template for the current hook set. This file is NOT auto-loaded — copy the entries you want into .claude/settings.json (or settings.local.json) to activate them. pre-ship-verify.js is not an event hook; it is a script the /ship phase runs.

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(process.platform!=='win32'&&/(pnpm( run)? dev\b|npm run dev\b|yarn dev\b|bun run dev\b)/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access');console.error('[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev \"pnpm dev\"');console.error('[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev');process.exit(2)}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

PreToolUse.description: Block dev servers outside tmux - ensures you can access logs

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/git push/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] Review changes before push...');console.error('[Hook] Continuing with push (remove this hook to add interactive review)')}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

PreToolUse.description: Reminder before git push to review changes

SessionStart.description: Scan active pitches' hill charts; warn about scopes stuck at the same uphill position across 3+ sessions

SubagentStop.description: Record a bounded local consumption snapshot when any subagent finishes

PostToolUse.description: Supplement foreground agent completions with Claude's final-request usage when available
Count skill invocations by name only; the skill's arguments are never stored
Deterministic post-edit quality gate: secrets, console.log, oversized components, missing auth guards, boundary + client-hook violations, TS syntax

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/gh pr create/.test(cmd)){const out=i.tool_output?.output||'';const m=out.match(/https:\/\/github.com\/[^/]+\/[^/]+\/pull\/\d+/);if(m){console.error('[Hook] PR created: '+m[0]);const repo=m[0].replace(/https:\/\/github.com\/([^/]+\/[^/]+)\/pull\/\d+/,'$1');const pr=m[0].replace(/.+\/pull\/(\d+)/,'$1');console.error('[Hook] To review: gh pr review '+pr+' --repo '+repo)}}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

PostToolUse.description: Log PR URL and provide review command after PR creation
